reason: The analyst ran a single unadjusted regression, trimmed on the outcome, and ignored the pre-period confounders (firm size, age, 2020 patents). That inflates the effect to 2.07, about 2.7 times the 0.75 I get with full pre-period controls (95% CI 0.30 to 1.20). Both analyses are positive, but the reported magnitude is not supported and only one specification was tested.
